extDescription.message: Keeps your Waseda Moodle session connected to your own Moodle MCP service. Unofficial — not affiliated with Waseda University.

hintConfigure.message: Set the service URL in Settings to get started.

resultSigninRequired.message: Moodle sign-in required. Sign in to Moodle; the connection then renews itself.

resultRateLimited.message: Too many attempts. Wait up to an hour; the extension tries again the next time you sign in to Moodle.

resultServerError.message: Service error. Try again later; if it keeps happening, open the console.

resultMoodleUnavailable.message: Waseda Moodle is not reachable (it may be under maintenance). Try again later.

resultNetworkError.message: Service unreachable. Check your network and the service URL in Settings.

resultPermissionMissing.message: Access to the service was not granted. Save the URL again in Settings.

helpServiceUrl.message: The HTTPS address of your Moodle MCP service. Saving asks for permission to contact it.

errorPermissionDenied.message: Permission was declined. The URL was not saved.

privacyBody.message: The extension reads only the MoodleSession cookie of wsdmoodle.waseda.jp, when needed, and does not store it. Signing out of Moodle in this browser ends the connection; the next sign-in reconnects automatically.

hintConsent.message: To connect, agree in Settings to sending your Moodle sign-in session.

consentLabel.message: Send my Moodle sign-in session to this server to connect my account and keep it connected.

errorConsentRequired.message: Tick the consent box to connect. Nothing is sent until you do.

hintSignIn.message: Sign in to Moodle in the opened tab. The connection then continues automatically.

noteSignOut.message: Signing out of Moodle in this browser ends the connection. The next sign-in reconnects automatically.
